## Summary

Mykolas Žygimantaitis, son of Žygimantas Kęstutaitis, commands the Lithuanians at [Pabaiskas](../events/ev_pabaiskas.qmd) in 1435 (with about 4,000 Poles under Jakub Kobylański).

## Record vs saga

- **[Record]:** VLE; en.wikipedia (Battle of Wiłkomierz): commander at Pabaiskas; after 1440 contested the throne against Casimir (Trakai voivodeship and Samogitia backed him 1440-41, Masovia until 1447); in 1448-49 with the Crimean khan took Starodub, Novhorod-Siverskyi and Kyiv; captured, died in Moscow shortly before 10 Feb 1452, poisoning suspected, buried in Vilnius cathedral. Birth year unknown.
- **[Saga invention]:** Rumours in Book V ch. 23 put him in Mozūrija, Moscow, or hiding in Samogitia.
